title: HDF Extension Primitives
description: Extension types for waivers, attestations, generators, and integrity.

type.description: The type of override. 'waiver' indicates risk acceptance. 'attestation' indicates manual verification.

status.description: The status this override sets for the requirement.

reason.description: Explanation for why this override was applied.

appliedBy.description: Identifier of who applied this override. Example: 'user@example.com' or system identifier.

appliedAt.description: Timestamp when this override was applied. ISO 8601 format.

expiresAt.description: Timestamp when this override expires and must be reviewed/renewed. REQUIRED - no permanent overrides allowed. ISO 8601 format.

signature.description: Optional digital signature for enhanced trust and non-repudiation.

Override.description: A status override applied to a requirement, such as a waiver or attestation. All overrides must have an expiration date to enforce periodic review.
Override.title: Override

name.description: The name of the tool that generated this file. Example: 'Chef InSpec'.

version.description: The version of the tool. Example: '5.22.3'.

Generator.description: Information about the tool that generated this HDF file.
Generator.title: Generator

algorithm.description: The hash algorithm used for the checksum.

signedBy.description: Identifier of who signed this file.

Integrity.description: Cryptographic integrity information for verifying the HDF file has not been tampered with. If algorithm is provided, checksum must also be provided, and vice versa.
Integrity.title: Integrity
